question: Who among the following has been honoured with Sports Journalists Federation of India (SJFT) Sportswoman of the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mira bai Chanu is also known as "Saikhom Mirabai Chanu" won the gold medal in 2017 at the World Weightlifting Championships in Anaheim (United States of America).
 
• She won the Gold medal in the Women's 48kg category.
 
• Mirabai Chanu was awarded Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2018.
 
• She was also honoured with Padam Shri in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sports Journalists Federation of India**

 
 
• It was **on 27 February 1976** that the Sports Journalists’ Federation of India (SJFI) was formed at the Eden Gardens, Calcutta, during the inaugural year of the** J.K. Bose Cricket Tournament.**
 
• The cream of sports scribes from **Delhi, Calcutta and Bombay **were involved in forming the federation.
 
• The Sports Journalists Federation of India (SJFI) has decided to confer the prestigious 'SJFI Medal' to legendary cricketer Sunil Gavaskar.
 
• Neeraj Chopra was adjudged the SJFI Sportsman of the Year while weightlifter Mirabai Chanu was voted as the Sportswoman of the Year.
 
• The Indian men's team that won the **hockey bronze in Tokyo was declared the Team of the Year**.
 
• The body took the decision at its **Annual General Meeting (AGM) in Guwahati**.
 
• The AGM also elected** A Vinod** as the new SJFI President, **Prashant Keni **as the Secretary, and **Vidyut Kalita **as the Treasurer.
